scenario.title: RAATE ROAD - 2 JAN 1940
intro.text:
RAATE ROAD - 2 JAN 1940

Raate-Suomussalmi Road, Eastern Finland

Our comrades from the 163rd division in Suomussalmi are cut off and need help. Break through the enemy encirclement and restore the supply route!

ORDERS
a. Reach the Exit Point (Road to Suomussalmi) with at least 5 of your ground units.
b. Prevent that the enemy destroy more than 4 of your units.

NOTES
a. The Finns will try to surprise you. Be aware!
b. Attention - winter conditions! If possible, equip your troops with tracked movement. Check if you can switch between wheeled and tracked movement for free.

CORE (recommended)
2x Tank
4x Infantry
2x Reconnaissance
2x Artillery
2x Fighter Aircraft (+1)
1x Tactical Bomber
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.reaction-briliant.text: Grodno and the northern roads were occupied before organised columns could escape. The speed shortened the fighting and multiplied the questions nobody wanted asked on the road.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.reaction-victory.text: The advance through Grodno reached the frontier. It did not make soldiers, militias, and refugees fit into the categories printed in our orders.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.reaction-tactical.text: We took Grodno by the narrow margin headquarters required. The border is closed; the arguments about what happened before it closed are not.
line.reaction-lose.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.reaction-lose.text: Grodno remained contested and organised columns reached Lithuania. Headquarters has sent us north before the road reports and the accusations have finished arriving.
line.callback-choice-a.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.callback-choice-a.text: The detached group that sealed Lithuania proved you will accept distance from headquarters. In these forests distance becomes silence after the first bend.
line.callback-choice-b.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.callback-choice-b.text: At Grodno you kept the advance on confirmed orders. Here confirmation arrives slowly enough to freeze, so control will have to travel with the column.
line.scene-0.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.scene-0.text: Engines freeze faster than the mechanics can warm them. The road is a narrow white corridor through trees; abandoned lorries already mark where a column stopped long enough for the forest to close around it.
line.scene-1.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.scene-1.text: The 163rd no longer calls as a division. One battalion asks for bread, another for antitank shells, a third only repeats its map square. Every hour turns an organised formation into separate voices.
line.decision.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.decision.text: A single heavy column carries guns and supplies but offers the enemy one long target. Smaller groups can screen the road and move through the trees, yet they risk arriving without the weight to break a roadblock.
line.decision.choice.drive-the-column.te: Keep the relief column concentrated and force the road open with weight.
line.decision.choice.drive-the-column.hi: Restore the core to at least eight strength with full fuel and ammunition, and give artillery 10 experience for road-column drill.
line.decision.choice.break-into-groups.t: Split into mutually supporting groups that clear the forest before the road column advances.
line.decision.choice.break-into-groups.h: Attach an experienced eight-strength mountain-infantry detachment and give all infantry 10 experience; winter equipment costs 40 prestige.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.choice-a-0.text: The guns remain together and every halt has a time limit. If the head of the column stops, the rear forms a perimeter before the enemy chooses one for us.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.choice-a-1.text: One road, one target. I will report every fresh ski track, but I cannot make the forest reveal which one belongs to the detachment waiting ahead.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.choice-b-0.text: Each group receives a compass bearing, a rendezvous, and authority to turn back before isolation becomes heroism. The road moves only after its flanks are reported clear.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.choice-b-1.text: I will walk the first rendezvous with them. If the groups miss it, nobody at this table will call their absence freedom of movement.
line.post-0.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.post-0.text: Move the wireless post to the first heated dugout. A frozen operator will turn any plan back into those separate voices.
